verdict.rationale: Goodwin's technology industry page lists "New company formation" as a service across the corporate life cycle, and its VC practice says it represents more than 1,200 emerging companies and entrepreneurs, so formation is clearly a firm offering. Its Founders Workbench Document Driver also generates Delaware C-corp and LLC formation documents for free, though the guide tells founders to consult their own advisors first. However, no evidence names the specific deliverables, and formation is only a single line item rather than documented as a core of the startup practice. Missing for 10: explicit coverage of charter, bylaws, initial board consents and founder stock purchase agreements; a dedicated emerging-companies formation practice description; independent or hands-on corroboration.
